title: Long Term Pediatric Vaccine Tender Scheduling with Quantity Discounts
abstract: arXiv:2610.19045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pediatric vaccine procurement for low- and lower-middle-income countries (LICs and LMICs) requires long-term coordination across heterogeneous vaccine markets, competing stakeholder objectives, and uncertain demand, yet tenders are currently scheduled as a series of independent renewals. We extend the Hypothetically Coordinated Vaccine Market (HCVM) framework to schedule multi-year tenders with flexible lengths and all-unit quantity discounts, and compare three objectives: a balanced coordinatingentity model (UG), a social-benefit model that minimizes missed doses (SB), and a producer profit-maximizing model (MP). Using UNICEF ten-year demand forecasts and 30 demand replications across six discount scenarios, we find that the procurement objective, not demand variability, drives cost-to-tender and schedule complexity. translated_title: 考虑数量折扣的长期儿科疫苗招标调度
translated_abstract: 低收入国家和中低收入国家（LICs和LMICs）的儿科疫苗采购需要在异构疫苗市场、相互竞争的利益相关者目标以及不确定需求之间进行长期协调，然而目前的招标却被安排为一系列独立的续约。我们扩展了假设协调疫苗市场（HCVM）框架，以安排具有灵活期限和全部单位数量折扣的多年期招标，并比较了三种目标：平衡的协调实体模型（UG）、最小化错过剂量数的社会效益模型（SB）以及生产商利润最大化模型（MP）。通过使用联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）十年需求预测数据，并在六个折扣场景下进行30次需求重复实验，我们发现决定招标成本和调度复杂度的是采购目标，而非需求波动性。数量折扣有利于大型生产商，导致市场集中并增加供应链的脆弱性。折扣效……
tldr: 该研究扩展了假设协调疫苗市场框架以安排带有数量折扣的多年期儿科疫苗招标，发现采购目标而非需求波动性是决定招标成本和调度复杂度的关键因素，且数量折扣会导致市场向大型生产商集中并增加供应链脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This study extends the Hypothetically Coordinated Vaccine Market framework to schedule multi-year pediatric vaccine tenders with quantity discounts, finding that the procurement objective—rather than demand variability—drives cost-to-tender and schedule complexity, while quantity discounts favor large producers, concentrate the market, and increase supply chain vulnerability.
